correct_completion: I will reply to your email tomorrow.
full_sentence: Although I am very busy, I will reply to your email tomorrow.
acceptable_variants: I will write back as soon as I can.

options.why_wrong: 'So' shows a result, but after 'although' the sentence needs a contrasting action.

options.text: I will reply to your email tomorrow.

options.why_wrong: This repeats the reason from the stem and does not give the contrasting action expected after 'although'.

options.text: I have a lot of work.
options.why_wrong: This adds more information about being busy but does not complete the contrast started by 'although'.

explanation: After 'although', we need a clause that shows contrast with the first part of the sentence. Here the contrast is between being busy and still replying.
translation: Хоча я дуже зайнятий, я відповім на твій лист завтра.
